flows.title: Add a product
steps: Click New product on the Products dashboard and select the product type you want.
Set the product's price. A product can be free, and a minimum price can be left open-ended with a plus sign so buyers may give more.
Describe the product in the editor, where you can style the text inline and add images, quotes, code blocks or embedded video.
Open the product's Content tab and add what the buyer receives — files, pages and embedded media, grouped into folders if you want.
Publish the product when it is ready.
